nativeAdapterExceptions.reason: Descriptor-anchored native read requires O_NOFOLLOW, bigint inode/device checks and bounded double reads. Effect acquisition/finalizers own returned buffers and wait uninterruptibly for issued native reads and descriptor closure.
Native callbacks expose physical close, socket readiness/frame bytes and process stdout outcomes. Named Effect adapters own cancellation and resource cleanup; no independent application runner.
Synchronous file transactions and native identity facts retain exclusive-write, permission, rename and token fences. Effect workflows own locks, helper invocation, deadlines and finalization.
Bounded source-free native artifact/diagnostic writes remain synchronous sink adapters. Callers compose workflows as Effect; persisted timestamps intentionally use epoch time.
Native binding discovery and parser process I/O remain host boundaries; language analysis, codecs and generated policy remain pure.
